parse_s3_bucket_key: parse an s3:// URI string and extract the bucket name and object key
list_s3_objects: list all objects in an S3 bucket prefix using the S3Helper ls method with pagination
download_s3_file: download a file from S3 to a local path using the S3Helper get_file method
check_s3_object_exists: check if an object exists in an S3 bucket using the S3Helper exists method
check_file_readable: check if a local file path exists and is readable using is_file_readable
